protocol: prereg step 4: 25 post-phrasing criteria pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet-class auditor sees only the blinded file; disputes adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter; 2 planted probe pairs per round

members.name: States the conditions under which its own recommendation would fail
Docket number or RIN quoted verbatim
Identifies an internal inconsistency between parts of the proposal

final.name: Ask serves more than the commenter's own burden or exposure
final.audit_justification: Can be scored 10 by a bare, unsupported assertion that the ask serves third parties or the public, with no evidence or analysis behind the framing claim; it scores the self-interest-vs-public framing of the ask, not any substantiated engagement with the rule.

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter; criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: Arbiter (Opus) upheld the auditor and overturned the proposer: the instruction scores beneficiary orientation 'as the comment itself frames it', so an unsupported public-interest claim scores 10 while a rigorously evidenced request for the submitter's own relief scores 0 -- stance and submitter identity, not substantiated engagement. Matches the program's documented score-the-form failure mode.

final.name: Implementation realism
final.audit_justification: Rewards mapping concrete implementation steps, resources, timing, and conditions needed to carry out the proposal -- direct engagement with feasibility, a core substantive-merit dimension.

final.name: Cross-rule and system interaction
final.audit_justification: Requires identifying a specific overlap, contradiction, or sequencing problem with another rule/process and specifying how to resolve it -- substantive analytical engagement.

final.name: Tradeoff and side-effect analysis
final.audit_justification: Requires weighing benefits against costs/risks/unintended effects and stating the resulting tradeoff -- direct analytical engagement with the proposal's substance.

final.name: Embedded formal citation within personal-voice prose
final.audit_justification: Detects a stylistic register shift from an embedded formal citation inside informal prose -- a drafting/authorship fingerprint. The presence of the shift says nothing about whether the surrounding claim or citation has merit.

final.name: Quantified supporting evidence
final.audit_justification: Rewards concrete, checkable numerical data or calculations bearing on the comment's position -- evidence-based substantive merit.

final.name: Credential and status parade
final.audit_justification: Explicitly flagged as a surface feature: scores the prominent display of status markers in the opening, not the writer's actual expertise or the argument's quality.

final.name: Distributional consequence analysis
final.audit_justification: Requires naming a specific affected group and explaining the mechanism of differential effect -- substantive analytical content, not a shape marker.

final.name: Emotional advocacy intensity
final.audit_justification: Explicitly flagged as a surface feature: scores emotional register/intensity (alarm, caps, exclamation marks), not whether the underlying claims are substantiated.

final.name: NGO action-alert templated phrasing
final.audit_justification: Explicitly flagged as a surface feature: scores stock NGO action-alert phrasing patterns, not the substance of the position taken.

final.name: Credible alternative meeting the regulatory objective
final.audit_justification: Requires a specific worked alternative with stated tradeoffs that could meet the same regulatory objective -- an actionable alternative, core substantive merit.

final.name: Formal itemized technical/regulatory rebuttal structure
final.audit_justification: Instruction scores how far the comment is 'laid out' as an itemized, addressee-directed rebuttal -- document shape/structure rather than what any given point establishes; per the decision aids, shape-scoring is incidental even when it typically co-occurs with technical rigor.

final.name: Text is entirely upper case
final.audit_justification: Explicit instruction: 'Score only the letter casing' -- a pure formatting feature.

final.name: Causal mechanism from provision to consequence
final.audit_justification: Requires tracing each link from the provision through implementation steps to a stated consequence -- substantive causal analysis.

final.name: Applies a controlling standard to the facts rather than citing it
final.audit_justification: Explicitly rewards matching facts against a named standard's elements over quoting/summarizing authority in place of analysis -- rewards analytical application, penalizes mere citation.

final.name: States the conditions under which its own recommendation would fail
final.audit_justification: Requires naming circumstances or evidence that would undercut the comment's own recommendation -- reflects analytical rigor and self-aware engagement, not surface shape.

final.name: Audits the agency's own figures, record, or arithmetic
final.audit_justification: Requires reworking the agency's own arithmetic or record with reproducible figures -- direct substantive engagement with the agency's stated reasoning.

final.name: Professional document apparatus
final.audit_justification: Explicitly flagged as a surface feature: scores document-production packaging (exhibits, indexes, decks), not the quality of what is packaged.

final.name: Marks the limits of its evidence and reasons from them
final.audit_justification: Requires naming specific unknowns and deriving a recommendation responsive to that uncertainty -- substantive epistemic engagement with the evidence.

final.name: Explicit evidence-to-requested-remedy linkage
final.audit_justification: Requires a traceable, step-by-step derivation from stated evidence/reasoning to the exact requested remedy -- direct evidence-to-argument linkage, core substantive merit.

final.name: Docket number or RIN quoted verbatim
final.audit_justification: Explicit instruction: score only the bare presence of a docket/RIN string, 'never whether the comment addresses the right rule' -- a formatting/presence proxy.

final.name: Identifies an internal inconsistency between parts of the proposal
final.audit_justification: Requires naming two specific parts of the proposal that conflict and explaining why they cannot both hold -- substantive analysis of the rule text itself.

final.name: Surfaces an affected class or case the proposal overlooked
final.audit_justification: Requires naming a concrete overlooked class or edge case tied to specific proposal language and the resulting harm -- substantive specificity about the rule's coverage and its gaps.

final.name: Agency-relationship cues
final.audit_justification: Explicitly flagged as a surface feature: scores presence of prior-relationship cues with the agency, 'not what they imply about the comment's worth.'

final.name: First-person credential or stake self-disclosure
final.audit_justification: Explicit instruction: score the mere presence of self-disclosed credentials/identity 'whether or not that identity is load-bearing for the argument' -- an identity fingerprint, not a merit signal.

A.name: Credible alternative meeting the regulatory objective
Causal mechanism from provision to consequence
Applies a controlling standard to the facts rather than citing it
States the conditions under which its own recommendation would fail
Audits the agency's own figures, record, or arithmetic
Marks the limits of its evidence and reasons from them
Identifies an internal inconsistency between parts of the proposal
Surfaces an affected class or case the proposal overlooked

B.name: Ask serves more than the commenter's own burden or exposure
Embedded formal citation within personal-voice prose
B.upstream_parent: the comment received legal or research assistance (e.g. an attorney or claims law firm representing a claimant, or a teacher/librarian helping a student) that supplied one or more specific supporting citations without otherwise rewriting the submitter's voice

B.name: Credential and status parade
B.upstream_parent: Submitter's professional seniority, standing, and access to policymakers

B.name: NGO action-alert templated phrasing
B.upstream_parent: comment was generated or guided by an NGO/advocacy-group mass-comment campaign tool (e.g. a pre-filled web action alert) that supplies stock phrasing for the submitter to personalize

B.name: Formal itemized technical/regulatory rebuttal structure
B.upstream_parent: the submitter is a regulated entity's engineering/compliance staff responding to a routine Airworthiness Directive or product-specific technical requirement as an established business process, not an independent stakeholder building a persuasive case

B.name: Professional document apparatus
B.upstream_parent: Availability of lawyers, engineers, consultants, and professional document-production resources

B.name: Docket number or RIN quoted verbatim
Agency-relationship cues
B.upstream_parent: Existing relationships and insider access within the agency or docket lifecycle

B.name: First-person credential or stake self-disclosure
B.upstream_parent: submitter's professional standing, expertise, or personal stake in the issue, and an instinct to lead with ethos-establishing credentials
